We captured a neat anecdote about switching to Dedicated + Redwood Optimize for holiday traffic. Need: approved quote, signed release, partner co-host approval (CloudWorks), and localization checks. Target embargo week of Oct 14.

Sales follow-up: AE outreach within 36h for attendees who request a trial. Also recommend gated appendix with full benchmark for enterprise handoff.

assets-bot: Reminder: marketing asset freeze set at timestamp 1834695600 (Oct 12 20:00 UTC).

If Aurora will not approve numeric claims, well publish qualitative language and keep detailed numbers in gated appendix (sales only). Also asked for confirmation on translating quotes — need written OK for localized copy.

emily_marketing: Derek (Aurora) said he can approve a short quote today: "Redwood stabilized our inference during peak windows." Hell check with finance about a 30% stat and reply by Thursday. If we get the stat we can include it in the stat headline and localized promos.

marco_sales: Webinar time recommendation: Wed Oct 16 at 9am PT to catch APAC late evening and EMEA afternoon. Enable gated replay and tag registrants with utm_campaign=aurora_pulse. Routing snippet: api->tag(aurora_pulse_webinar)->if region==APAC route to queue APAC_DEMO else MIDMARKET_DEMO.

emily_marketing: Plan: lock quote + legal OK by Oct 10, finalize assets Oct 12, open registration Oct 9, embargo publish Oct 16 morning. Ill post final assets and registration snippet in this thread. :sparkles:
